test_title: PYST 54: SSC CPO - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question:
The given pie chart shows the distribution of land under various food crops. The expenditure invested on these food crops is Rs. 25,000 per annum. Study the pie chart carefully and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1321623b298165454a7f5e5ef359446eb5a1daf380146460ace6d5ab81f82fa.png] 

The expenditure invested in Rice and Barley is what percentage (correct to 2 decimal places) of the expenditure invested in Wheat and Bajra?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total expenditure invested in Rice and Barley = 50% + 12% = 62%

Total expenditure invested in Wheat and Bajra = 20% + 10% = 30%

According to the question,

⇒ 62/30 × 100 = 206.66%

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
